vision.name: Vegito
vision.text:
(Your Drills are not discarded when advancing or lowering from this level.)
[Continuous]: Your energy attacks deal +1 life card of damage.
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects requires you to discard 1 card from your hand during combat. Draw a card and raise your anger 1 level.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Search your Life Deck for a Drill and place it into play.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Search your discard pile for 3 Styled cards and Rejuvenate them.
